name: Water
oneLine: The liquid everything else floats in. Life as we know it needs it.
howItWorks: Water molecules are tiny and always moving. They pull on each other and on anything charged. That pull makes oily things clump together and lets charged things dissolve.
deeper: A drop of water holds more molecules than there are stars in the observable universe. Water pushing oily tails together is what makes membranes form on their own.
sizeComparison: a 300,000th the width of a hair
simplification: We show only a few water molecules, as haze. Real water is packed shoulder to shoulder.
